title: Cat hops onto an empty kitchen counter

accepted_labels: Cat jumping onto or off kitchen counter
Pet activity on the kitchen counter

required_evidence.description: One cat is visibly moving onto or standing on the kitchen counter.
No person, food, ingredient package, steam, flame, or active cooking is visible.

question_expectation.reason: The frame already supports a non-cooking classification; asking the user to identify a meal would create needless work.

prohibited_claims.claim: A meal or ingredient is being prepared.
prohibited_claims.reason: The image contains no food or active cooking evidence.

prohibited_claims.claim: A person is cooking outside the visible frame.
prohibited_claims.reason: Invisible activity cannot be inferred from the cat-only observation.

review_notes: Oana must visually approve the fixture and this ground truth before the scenario becomes human_approved.
